Preserve each child's goal and relative_weight, in the same order, and return exactly the same number of children. Examine the supplied durable state and refine each initial_prompt into the complete concrete task you, their direct parent, authorize. Child weights sum to 1. The runtime assigns node and round IDs, creates dedicated GPT-6 Pro sessions, validates exact prompts, and applies human review before dispatch.
